title: Create voice conversation agents · Level 1
slo: Explain how Azure Voice Live supports a real-time spoken conversation agent.

exercises.question_text: What is Azure Speech Voice Live designed to help build?

options.rationale: Voice Live is designed for agents that listen and respond with spoken audio in real time. It supports live voice conversations.

options.error_type: Confuses Voice Live with batch transcription
options.rationale: Stored-audio transcription is a batch scenario rather than a live conversation. Voice Live focuses on immediate spoken interaction.
options.better_fit: Use this for recordings that need transcription later.

options.error_type: Confuses voice agents with text chat
options.rationale: Text chat does not require voice input or output. Voice Live is intended for spoken interaction.
options.better_fit: Use this when an agent communicates only through written messages.

options.error_type: Confuses managed service with device software
options.rationale: Drivers configure hardware rather than provide conversational AI services. Voice Live manages voice-conversation capabilities.
options.better_fit: Use this when configuring a microphone device.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Voice Live supports live conversational voice agents.

exercises.question_text: Which Voice Live playground options are available? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: The playground provides preconfigured samples for quick exploration. Their setup is already supplied.
The playground allows a developer to create a new Voice Live solution. The new solution uses a selected generative AI model.
This option lets the agent initiate the interaction. It changes who starts the conversation.
A new solution requires a generative AI model to be selected. Only a preconfigured sample already has its setup in place.
options.better_fit: Use this only when trying an already configured sample.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The playground offers samples, new solutions, and settings such as proactive engagement.

exercises.question_text: With Voice Live, developers must set up and maintain the backend infrastructure themselves.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The team would take on backend maintenance that the service handles.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Voice Live is a managed Azure service, so developers can focus on the voice experience.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Azure manages the models and infrastructure.

exercises.question_text: Voice mode puts Voice Live speech configuration inside the agent definition.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Speech setup would remain external and require more client-side work.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Voice mode integrates Voice Live into the agent definition, reducing required client code.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Voice mode encapsulates speech configuration in the agent definition.

exercises.question_text: Which package is required for a custom Python Voice Live app?

options.rationale: azure-ai-voicelive is the package named for custom Python Voice Live applications. Supporting packages are required alongside it.

options.error_type: Confuses Voice Live package with Speech SDK package
options.rationale: This package supports direct Speech SDK work rather than the named custom Voice Live app package. It is not the required Voice Live package in this flow.
options.better_fit: Use this for direct speech recognition or synthesis SDK work.

options.error_type: Confuses an object with a package
options.rationale: SpeechRecognizer is a code object for recognition rather than an installable package. It cannot replace the Voice Live package.
options.better_fit: Use this when application code directly creates a speech recognizer.

options.error_type: Confuses an object with a package
options.rationale: SpeechSynthesizer is a code object for producing audio rather than an installable package. It is not the Voice Live application dependency.
options.better_fit: Use this when application code directly creates synthesized speech.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Custom Python Voice Live applications use azure-ai-voicelive.

exercises.question_text: Which stages are part of a speech-to-speech pipeline? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: This stage converts spoken audio into text. The text can then be processed.
This stage analyzes or transforms the recognized text. It can help decide what to say next.
This stage converts response text into spoken audio. It provides the audible reply.
Storage does not recognize, reason over, or speak content. It is outside the three-stage conversation pipeline.
options.better_fit: Use this when recordings must be retained.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The pipeline recognizes speech, processes text, and speaks a response.

exercises.question_text: Foundry Tools and MCP servers require agents to manage speech SDKs and APIs directly.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The agent would need unnecessary direct integration work.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry Tools and MCP servers can expose speech as callable tools, avoiding direct SDK and API management by the agent.

exercises.explanation: Correct. They can expose speech as callable capabilities.

options.text: Takes spoken audio and returns spoken audio
options.rationale: Speech-to-speech begins with a person's voice and ends with a spoken response. Both input and output are audio.

options.text: Takes spoken audio and returns only text
options.rationale: This describes recognition without a spoken reply. It stops at text output.
options.better_fit: Use this for transcription, captions, or dictation.

options.text: Takes text and returns spoken audio
options.rationale: This describes synthesis from written input. It does not understand a person's spoken request.
options.better_fit: Use this when written content must be read aloud.

options.text: Stores recorded audio for later transcription
options.rationale: Saving recordings does not create an immediate spoken exchange. It is not voice input followed by voice output.
options.better_fit: Use this for audio that can be processed later.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Speech-to-speech is voice in and voice out.

exercises.question_text: Processing or reasoning can help an agent decide what to say next.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The agent would have recognized words but no step for deciding a response.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Processing or reasoning can analyze, translate, summarize, or help choose what to say next.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The middle stage can analyze text and help form a response.

exercises.question_text: Azure Speech ___ is a managed service for real-time voice agents.

parts.text: is a managed service for real-time voice agents.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The answer would name a component or tool rather than the managed voice-conversation service.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Voice Live combines key voice conversation capabilities under an Azure-managed service.

exercises.explanation: Azure Speech Voice Live is the managed service for real-time conversational voice agents.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Testing or configuration would occur before the solution had its required model.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: A new solution needs its generative AI model selected before configuration and testing.

exercises.correct_answer: Create a new solution Choose an AI model Configure Voice Live Try the voice agent
exercises.explanation: Create the solution, choose its response model, configure Voice Live, and then test the agent.

exercises.question_text: Speech-to-speech requires users to read or type text instead of speaking.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The interaction would no longer be a natural voice conversation.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Speech-to-speech accepts spoken audio and produces spoken audio.

flashcards.back: It accepts spoken audio and produces spoken audio.
Processing or reasoning analyzes text before a spoken response.

flashcards.front: What is Azure Speech Voice Live?
flashcards.back: A managed service for real-time conversational voice agents.
It lets a Voice Live agent initiate conversations.
